checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One assembled 15-second 16:9 film in three distinct shots
must.why: The clip is 5 s with one continuous shot on the same sidewalk.

must.item: Woman keeps freckles and red pixie cut in all shots
must.why: She has long blonde hair in a ponytail, no red pixie cut, and no freckles are visible.

must.item: Man keeps shaved head and round glasses in all shots
must.why: He has styled brown hair and no glasses.

must.item: Both faces clearly visible in every shot
must.why: Faces are visible in profile or partly hidden in the hug, and there are no three shots.

must.item: Red scarf dropped, picked up, returned, ending with mutual smiles
must.why: No scarf sequence is shown. A small red item may appear in frame 2, but nothing is dropped or returned. They do end smiling.
The look is realistic, but the audio cannot be judged from frames.

faults.what: The clip ignores the required three-shot, 15-second structure and the scarf story.
The characters do not match the required identities: the woman is blonde and the man has hair and no glasses.
The hug in frame 2 looks like a kiss, with slightly warped hands and merged figures, which is not a friendly greeting.

summary: The output is a realistic 5-second single-shot sidewalk greeting, but it misses the required 15-second three-shot scarf story and the specified character looks (red pixie cut, shaved head, round glasses).
